description.value: A convenience store in remote Northern BC serving the Omineca region. Functions as a general store and resupply stop for the local community and travelers passing through. Located in one of BC's most isolated areas.

raw_osm.name: Omineca General Store
raw_osm.source: Visual comparison of Maxar imagery and masthead photograph at <http://ominecageneralstore.ca/>

enrichment_extras.reasoning: OSM identifies Omineca General Store as a convenience shop with phone and website URL verified by Maxar imagery comparison. enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, publicly accessible convenience store in a remote area. OSM imagery verification and looks_closed=false support operational status. A touring cyclist resupply stop in Northern BC is valuable regardless of unconfirmed amenities.
